reviews.text:
We brought our dog Milo to this veterinary center almost a month ago, after several weeks of worry, uncertainty, and despair. Since mid-August, we had been taking him to another veterinarian because he was getting progressively worse: he was lethargic, had no desire to play, barely moved, and practically wasn't eating or drinking. After several visits to different veterinarians, we received different diagnoses, from a sore throat to prostatitis and, finally, a possible herniated disc. Meanwhile, Milo continued to deteriorate, and no one could figure out what was wrong with him.
We came here on the recommendation of a family member, and without a doubt, it was the best decision we could have made. Thanks to the entire team, today we can say that Milo is with us and that they saved his life. That same night, they had to admit him to the ICU, as he was suffering from peritonitis and his condition was very serious. He underwent emergency surgery, and little by little, thanks to their care and professionalism, Milo has returned to being the cheerful, playful, and vibrant dog he always was. We can never thank Alicia enough for the love, sweetness, and affection with which she welcomed Milo when he was so ill. To Jacobo, for being attentive to him at all times, and to Diego, for all the care, pampering, and help he offered us in the following days, accompanying us and answering our questions every step of the way. I also don't want to forget Susana, who greets us every week with open arms and a charming smile, making us feel right at home.

Beyond their enormous professionalism and knowledge, I would especially highlight their human qualities. In such difficult times, when you're afraid of losing someone so important to you, finding people who care for your pet with so much love and who are genuinely concerned about their recovery is priceless. They inspire confidence, peace of mind, and the assurance that your companion is in the best hands.
You are a fantastic team, and a veterinary center I would recommend without hesitation. Thank you for saving Milo's life, for treating him with such care, for being there for us every step of the way, and for your immense concern for his health and recovery.
Milo will always be part of our family, and knowing we have professionals like you gives us immense peace of mind.
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for everything you've done for him and for us. You are wonderful. ❤️

This veterinary clinic is undoubtedly the perfect place to have peace of mind about your pets. They offer excellent service and interactive communication with the veterinarian via WhatsApp.
It's the perfect choice, even if you have to travel.
I had a pet treated there yesterday and I have nothing but praise for it. The vet was very kind and professional.

Excellent service, both from the person who greeted us, who was very kind and friendly, and from the veterinarian, Diego, who took his time and treated the kittens with great care and professionalism. It was their first visit. Our kittens now have their own vet.
The experience has been exceptional; all the staff are attentive, friendly, and highly professional. Without a doubt, this will be the veterinary center for my kitten. I highly recommend the clinic.

I say this from the bottom of my heart: there's no better place to take your ferrets. We've taken ours there their whole lives and have absolutely no complaints. They'll receive the best care in the world, both personally and professionally, which is ultimately what gives you the most peace of mind; knowing they're in the best hands, especially during critical moments.

We live about 45 minutes away, but the trust we have in Menescalia makes it all worthwhile.

Thank you, Alicia and Jacobo, for the care and attention given to our rabbit. It has been a pleasure meeting you and being in your hands. Your expertise, decisiveness, and exceptional treatment have made the ordeal of seeing our little one so ill much easier. We are very grateful and happy with our pet's new veterinarians.
I contacted them about a problem with my pet rabbit, and Alicia helped me. Their attention, speed, clarity, and friendliness are what truly set them apart! Thank you so much for everything.
Of all the veterinary teams I've visited, and there have been quite a few, this is the best!
Very attentive, and excellent veterinarians. Susana and Alicia are very kind.
Fantastic from start to finish. My four cats always go to them; they're completely trustworthy, professional, friendly, and loving with the animals. A 10 out of 10!

I've been taking my 15-year-old dog there for several years now, and I couldn't be happier or more at ease leaving him in their care. Years ago, he had surgery for a hernia, and it went perfectly. A few months ago, I had to take him to another vet because I was away, and they told me he had kidney failure and that it could be a matter of months or weeks. I took him back to Menescalia, and they repeated the blood tests and explained that it was chronic kidney failure and that with treatment and a more specific diet, he could have many more years of good quality of life. I felt much more at ease because they explained things to me much better and more tactfully. I want to give a special mention to Diego, as he has always taken care of my dog. He is a very attentive and friendly person who, even when I've taken my dog ​​in for something more serious, has written to me the next day to ask how he was doing.
My first consultation gave me a very good feeling. The pet was very well received, and the support they use, both the app and WhatsApp, works very well.

My experience has been incredibly compassionate. I felt supported every step of the way, both during my kitten's illness and during the most difficult moment, his final moments. I found this clinic after years of searching for one that would treat my pets with quality and efficiency, and where they treat us owners as what our animals are to us: part of our family. Don't hesitate to visit them because you'll feel the same way I do today: sad to lose a member of my feline family, but also grateful to have done everything possible for him and given him a dignified, loving, and peaceful death.

Thank you, Diego, for your professional excellence and your wonderful character.

Our puppy had to have a leg amputated, and Diego monitored his post-operative care. They were with us throughout his recovery, and the clinic team treated us with such kindness.

Diego and Susana were always available to lend a hand whenever something unexpected came up, and they helped us resolve several emergencies with a warmth and dedication that we truly appreciated.

We were especially touched by the compassionate way they treated Benito. Without a doubt, this is a clinic we would trust again and highly recommend.

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the clinic team for their care and, above all, for the love and concern they showed Benito during some very difficult days.

Diego and Susana were attentive to him at all times and helped us with every emergency that arose, always with immense patience, professionalism, and empathy. On one occasion, even after we had already arrived home, they returned to attend to Benito when we needed them.

In moments like these, when you're worried and don't quite know what to do, finding a team that provides reassurance and is truly committed makes a huge difference.

Thank you so much for looking after Benito, for always helping us when we needed it, and for treating him with such care. Without a doubt, this is a clinic we highly recommend.

At reception, I think the girl's name was Susana, very polite and nice. The veterinarians, Alicia and Diego, were absolute professionals; they helped us with everything related to the treatment, the process, and finally, the passing of our dog, Sandy. It was a shame, but it was more bearable having people like them by our side. Thank you so much!
I've been several times with my kitten and I'll keep going; they inspire a lot of confidence and the service is great, they explain everything and put you at ease.
We are delighted with the care our kittens are receiving and the follow-up they get. They treat them like family, asking about their progress and answering any questions we may have.
I've been taking my dogs there for over three years and I'm delighted with the service. They care about them and are incredibly attentive. We're practically part of the Menescalia family!

Excellent personal and professional service.
Alicia treated us wonderfully.
Highly recommended in every way.
I've been taking my cats there for years and I'm very happy with them. They're very professional and caring with the animals. Highly recommended.

An excellent clinic. The entire Menescalia team stands out for their professionalism, friendly approach, and the care they show to the animals and their families. It's very reassuring to know our pets are in such good hands. Highly recommended.
Great service, very professional and trustworthy.

I think I've known this center for at least 20 years, maybe a little more.
This is the third pet they've taken care of for me, and I'm delighted.
First it was a chow chow, then a kitten who's now 8 years old (since she was three days old). And now my latest kitten, who's already 4 months old.
The care is exceptional; they really care about the animals and give them thorough checkups.
And the personal attention is excellent.
It's a one-on-one, personalized experience. I recommend it 100%.
Excellent service, very good treatment, and outstanding professionals.

I've been going to Menescalia for years, and the service is top-notch. A special mention goes to Diego, who has managed to get Fito to go to the vet without fear, which, for us, speaks volumes about the care he receives.

He's a reactive dog with other dogs, and they always take great care to keep him calm and avoid stressful situations.

Yesterday, we had to go in for an emergency, and even though we called that same day, they made time for him. They treated him with immense patience, care, and professionalism, as always.

It's very reassuring to know you can count on a team like this. Thank you for taking such good care of Fito!

Both Diego and Alicia are excellent professionals; they treat Mylo with great care and dedication.

They explain everything to me clearly. I highly recommend them.
Great professionals who are always there when we need them, and excellent facilities. Thank you so much for taking care of Tulipán and Rubio.

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude for the care my cat received at this veterinary clinic. Yesterday, we had a very difficult time because she suffered several neurological episodes that frightened us greatly, and from the moment we arrived, we felt supported and cared for with great professionalism.

The entire team treated us with exceptional kindness, showing great empathy towards both my cat and me. They took the necessary time to examine her, explain the situation clearly, and answer all our questions, something that is greatly appreciated in such a worrying situation.

In addition to their evident knowledge and experience, I want to highlight the care and gentleness with which they treated my cat throughout the entire appointment. It's clear they love animals and are truly committed to their well-being.

Thank you for your dedication, your patience, and for providing reassurance during such a difficult time. Without a doubt, this is a clinic you can fully trust, and I would recommend it to anyone who wants their pet to be in the best hands.

This clinic is the best thing that could have happened to us. My kitten had a serious problem that could have required veterinary attention at any moment. Being able to count on Diego for this has been a huge relief, as has Alicia, who treated her at the clinic. They are both excellent professionals with a friendly and very humane approach, so important in those uncertain times and throughout the entire process. We will always be grateful to them.

My experience was excellent. They were very caring and the service was very personal. Alicia was incredibly professional, explaining all the tests she performed on the dog, and Diego, in addition to being professional, made sure the dog was okay and spoke with the specialist after the surgery.
Superhuman, super professional, I can't say a bad word about them. A 10 out of 10!

From day one, they've inspired so much confidence in us. They always treat my pets with incredible care, have endless patience with them, and it's clear they genuinely care about their well-being and health. Taison and Tiza are thrilled with Alicia, and so am I! 🧡 …
Exceptional service, intensive follow-up even on weekends, Alicia is an incredible professional, full of patience and love for our pets, 10 out of 10.
a team of 10
Very nice people and very professional.

I've been taking my tortoise to Menescalia for about a year now and I'm 100% satisfied. The staff is very kind and they treat my pet very well. Recently, my "little one" was a bit unwell, and Diego, his vet, was very attentive and monitored him until he recovered. I have complete confidence in Diego and wouldn't take my tortoise anywhere else.
I've been taking all my pets there for a long time; they are very kind and caring with them. They are truly very professional and I highly recommend them.

I took my ferrets there and it was great, they were quick, attentive, and for animals like ferrets that you can't take to just any vet, this place has everything you need. Plus, the prices are reasonable and they provide excellent aftercare, which is much appreciated.

A few months ago, my little ferret, Iron, developed a benign tumor on his skull. Although it wasn't malignant, it bothered and hurt him. He wouldn't let me pet his head anymore, he was listless, and it was clear he wasn't well, so I made one of the hardest decisions: to operate.

It wasn't a simple operation because of the tumor's location.

I won't lie, those were very difficult days for me. I think all of us who have pets know how hard it is when something happens to them, and the worst part is that you can't do anything but care for them, trust, and wait.

My ferrets are my children; I love them with all my heart.

Luckily, my little ferret is incredibly strong and is now fully recovered!

He's back to being as mischievous and playful as ever, which is why I wanted to take this opportunity to thank Menescalia, my vet Jacobo, Alicia, and Susana. Thank you because I truly couldn't have felt in better hands. The love, patience, and care they showed Iron and me during such a vulnerable time is invaluable.

When you love your animals so much, finding a place where they are truly cared for and looked after makes all the difference.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart ❤️
They were very involved and attentive to my cat. They kept an eye on him after the visit. They even suggested solutions to a long-standing problem… highly recommended.

Highly recommended. I adopted a ferret and when we went to the vet, the staff were friendly and attentive, explaining everything in detail in the best possible way. The customer service was excellent, and they treated the pet very well. They vaccinated my ferret and she didn't even notice.

The care I received was always excellent—very humane and understanding. They know how to handle cats very well and avoid causing them stress! They are very attentive to follow-up appointments and annual check-ups. I highly recommend them. Be prepared for a wait in the waiting room.
Excellent service, very professional and understanding throughout the process and with the care of my animals. Thank you for everything!

Excellent service from both the reception staff and the vet, who, by the way, doesn't charge extra fees, only for what your pet needs. There are other places that run unnecessary tests. Highly recommended.

They were negligent with my cat.

I took my cat to the vet for vaccinations and blood work. I didn't see the blood drawn because they took her into a room (Alicia, the vet, and the receptionist). They told me they couldn't do it because she got too nervous. When I got home, my cat was limping on her back leg; she couldn't walk properly and was constantly whining. More than four days have passed, and she hasn't regained her normal mobility.

Furthermore, I went back to get it fixed, and the "secretary"/"assistant" denied that they had tried to draw blood from any of her back legs, even though I removed the bandage from her back leg myself at home. Very unpleasant and completely untrustworthy.
We took our kitten Rita to be spayed, and although she made it very difficult, the operation and the treatment were outstanding.
We've been bringing our dog here since she was a puppy and everything has always been great. A fantastic team who genuinely care.
The best veterinary clinic in Valencia!!! I don't know any others, but I wouldn't trade it for anything... Always so helpful and professional, thank you so much to the whole team.
The best professionals!!! They're a wonderful team!!!

Our cat was extremely ill, and besides saving his life, the care and humanity shown by the staff has been truly amazing! We admire the genuine dedication they have demonstrated every day of this long process.
They helped me in the last part of my dog's life. I couldn't be happier with the treatment Diego and Susana gave me, both medically and personally.
Exceptional service. We called for an emergency at 3 a.m. and they arrived immediately with exceptional professionalism and service. 100% recommended.

I have no words to describe this veterinarian. I have an American Staffordshire Terrier/Pitbull mix, and it's always been very difficult to get him treated at any vet. Unfortunately, we had an emergency at 3:00 AM, and Diego, the veterinarian, didn't hesitate to come to the vet and stay with the dog until he was better. He called us every day to ask how he was doing and kept a close eye on him. I highly recommend him if you love your pets.
The best!! We've been relying on them for over 20 years for all the furry members of the family.

Menescalia has been our veterinary clinic for about 14 years, and they've always taken care of Lluna and Mika with so much love and professionalism. From the moment you walk through the door and Susana greets you with a smile, you feel like you're going to be treated like family. Then there's Jacobo, who's a great veterinarian, and Diego, who's also excellent and has been with our girls for the last few years. And of course, there's Alicia, the newest addition to the team, who is a truly special and highly professional staff member. We only have words of gratitude for all of them.
Now Lluna and Mika are gone, and our hearts are broken, but we also have the satisfaction of knowing we enjoyed their company so much and all the love they gave us, as always, without asking for anything in return.

Hi, I've been taking my pets there for many years; for me, it's the best veterinary clinic. The service has always been, and continues to be, very professional and friendly. They are all excellent veterinarians. I recommend it 100%.
They're amazing at this clinic 🫶 and they treat my baby 🐕 so well! Thanks to Diego's care, my dog ​​recovered so quickly! 100% recommended!! ❤️❤️❤️❤️ …
They were amazing at handling my dog's pregnancy and so attentive to everything; it's a pleasure to deal with such professional vets.
Very professional. They took wonderful care of our dog. Thank you.
Excellent service from the very first minute, they were incredibly attentive to our furry friend. A 10 out of 10 for the service.

My experience with this clinic was extremely negative and unpleasant. I took my cat in because he'd been having coughing/sneezing episodes for 2-3 weeks. The vet who saw me categorically stated that my cat didn't have asthma, misinterpreting a lateral X-ray. She told me to send her a video of the episodes and that we would review it. In the following days, the frequency and intensity of the episodes increased, and I became so scared that I almost had to rush to the emergency vet. Four or five days later, another vet called to confirm, also categorically, that yes, they were indeed asthmatic episodes and needed urgent treatment. The corticosteroids calmed the episodes, but the explanations and treatment were ambiguous and incorrect. She even made a mistake writing the prescription and sent me an asthma mask as if it were candy, without warning me how extremely complicated and stressful it is to apply and without telling me that he would need an adjustment period. Zero empathy in handling these kinds of situations; it felt like... They rush through appointments rather than listen to what you're telling them. When they spoke to me, they kept getting the information I'd already given about my cat wrong, and despite communicating only the bare minimum, they seemed overwhelmed or annoyed that you were getting stressed and communicating with them too much (despite the number of mistakes and their ineptitude). They didn't even draw blood properly, as the animal left the lab with a significant wound. I don't know how they are with dogs and other animals, but they have no idea about feline medicine or behavior, and I don't recommend them for cats. They might manage a vaccine or a flea and tick treatment, but the moment there are complications and you have to handle something important, FIND ANOTHER CLINIC. And by the way, their split payment system doesn't work, even though they tell you it does. So if you can't pay in one go, find another clinic. They wouldn't accept my card, and instead of passing the buck by saying it was my card, we tried another card belonging to someone with a €2000 monthly salary and years of job stability, and it wouldn't accept that one either. The woman kept saying it was the cards' fault, lol. I've paid with credit cards at other vets without any problems, and everything went through correctly. I'm tempted to sue them for negligence, but I don't want to waste any more time there.

I want to thank Menescalia for the attention and service we've received over the years. We've spent so much time there lately; it's practically our second home these past few months. Lluna and Mika have enjoyed the professionalism and kindness of the entire team: Jacobo, Susana, Diego, and Alicia. We are so grateful to them all for their hard work and dedication.
Special thanks to Diego, who has always been there, tirelessly helping us with everything we've needed. Thank you.

From the very first moment, the care we received from Diego was exceptional. He stands out not only for his great professionalism but also for his warmth, empathy, and the way he treated us at every appointment.
We always felt heard and supported, with clear explanations, patience, and dedication. His love for his work and for animals is evident; he takes care of every detail and always seeks the best outcome in every situation.
Throughout the entire process, his attention was constant, respectful, and full of sensitivity, something we as a family greatly appreciate. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a trustworthy veterinarian. Thank you for everything, Diego. 😊
Very professional and excellent service.

We've been customers for about 20 years, for both ferrets and cats. They're incredibly professional, and we're delighted with both their personal service and how they treat our pets. Add to that the wonderful people who work there—Jacobo, Susana, Alicia, Diego—it's clear they love what they do and how much the animals love them! Absolutely recommended!

Diego is a great professional, very attentive. He explains things honestly and clearly to pet owners and treats our animals with great respect.
I wish there were more veterinarians with such dedication!
My experience with Diego couldn't be better. Since my dog ​​has been in his care, his allergies have remained stable. It's a pleasure to work with such competent professionals.
The best clinic in all of Valencia! The service is superb. Without a doubt, the best place to take your pet!

He's the best veterinarian I've ever known. He helps me with absolutely everything, making everything so easy! I've known him for over 10 years, and he's the best clinic I know. I have no words to describe Diego. He's my trusted veterinarian, and I've known him for all this time. Besides being my vet at the animal shelter, he's incredibly dedicated. When there's an emergency, he gives his all, his whole life, absolutely, to saving the animals. Besides being the best and most qualified, he's the only one who is truly committed to being better, no matter what! He strives to be the best every single day. In Valencia and Castilla-La Mancha, he's the best, and his clinic is the best, with all his guidance, everything... the best care. He's not just my vet, he's my friend, and I can confidently say that he has the best clinic in Valencia!
Excellent service and professionalism. They provide all the information you need, and Diego maintains constant communication. A 10 out of 10.

I'm very happy with this clinic. My dog ​​tore his cruciate ligaments and had to have surgery.

He was putting weight on his leg after three days, and he was walking normally again within a week.

I highly recommend them.

I can't say a bad word about this veterinary clinic. The professionals are top-notch! They also follow up via WhatsApp after the consultation or emergency, which you won't find anywhere else. Everyone is genuinely concerned and always tries to find a solution.

I've taken my dog ​​there for several years and they always treated us well, but two weeks ago, she had surgery and we felt like they gave up on her and left her to die. We took her to another vet and even to the hospital where she's been hospitalized, and it's here that I've seen the lack of professionalism and humanity. The hospital asked them for the test results they had done, and they haven't given them to us. We took her in for post-surgery follow-up, and they always said she was fine, but the animal was getting weaker and weaker. Both the hospital and the other vet we took her to were shocked and appalled at how this had been handled. In the end, today we had to put our dog down, and we're in enormous pain and unbearable distress. I hope that if anyone takes their pet here, please, in difficult situations, seek a second opinion if you care about your pet. Thank you all, and enjoy your pet while you can. I can't anymore.
Excellent service from the professionals. I recommend this clinic because of their love for our pets.

My dog ​​had surgery, it all went very well, without any problems, and the dog didn't complain about anything at all, especially to a young woman we went to for a check-up who treated her very well and was very professional!
My dog ​​Lola had surgery and everything went wonderfully, both the clinic and the veterinarians, very nice people and very attentive to my dog.
Beware of this veterinary clinic because they left my cat lame and then washed their hands of it. The vet and the receptionist gave her a vaccine and tried to draw blood, and she left there limping!
Very attentive to everything, very professional! 100% recommended
They did a very professional job, always attentive in case I needed anything. They are lovely and their work is impeccable.
Excellent professionals, without a doubt the best veterinarian
Bad experience, they had medical negligence and now I'm with another professional to help me see if it's reversible or not.

I had a scary experience with my puppy! I went to the clinic on Saturday, March 21, 2026. I saw a number posted for emergencies and called immediately. I am truly grateful for the care I received. First, they calmed me down with professional words, and then they explained in detail what had happened and what steps to take if anything else occurred.
Professional, ethical, timely, and effective! Thank you! Thank you!
The best professionals for the care of your pets. My ferrets are always well cared for when needed.
Fantastic service! My Ros came in with a kidney problem... and now she's walking around the house like a queen. Wonderful professionals.

I took my ferret in for a bladder stone problem, and he couldn't have been in better hands. From the very first moment, the treatment was impeccable: a highly professional, friendly, and attentive team who took the time to explain each step of the process and patiently answered all my questions. Throughout the treatment and surgery, they were attentive to every detail, conveying calm and confidence at all times.
The operation went perfectly, and they offered me every possible assistance with follow-up and aftercare. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic; their human and professional qualities are exceptional.

I can only say that I'm so happy I discovered this veterinary clinic. They were so involved in my ferret's adoption that I'm going to try to adopt a second one. They're incredibly empathetic, respond quickly, and are very flexible with scheduling, making everything so easy. I wouldn't give them more stars if I could!
They specialize in ferrets, dogs, and cats, and I recommend them 100%.

I called them on a Sunday night for an emergency and they immediately attended to my African Grey parrot. They are 100% professional, friendly, and incredibly caring and attentive to the animals. And even after you leave the clinic, they follow up with your pet no matter the time. 10/10, the best clinic.
Excellent service and very good veterinarians
This is the best ferret clinic in Valencia. The team is amazing, and Dr. Jacobo is the best vet your ferret could have.

I took my dog ​​Dino for a dental cleaning and was very happy with the service. From the first moment, they treated us with great kindness, explained the procedure in detail, and answered all my questions. Dino was in very good hands, and the cleaning was perfect. You can tell they care about the animals' well-being. Thank you so much! 🐾💙

On Saturday at 10:00 PM, I took my bunny Coco in for an emergency, and Alicia took care of her. I give her a 10000000 rating; she's super professional. Thanks to her, my bunny is happy again. Thank you so much! 😊 You're wonderful for caring so much. ❤️ …
Great place with high-quality service. I liked everything.

Amazing! I had no way to take my dog ​​to the vet because he's so big and couldn't walk. They picked him up at home, examined him, took x-rays, and prescribed treatment. They were also incredibly kind and made us both feel very special. I highly recommend them; I've found my forever vet.

They killed my ferret. She was two years old and perfectly healthy. I took her to have a chemically neutered implant. She was dead three hours later. Of course, they washed their hands of it. It was a "coincidence" that she died three hours after the procedure.

I used to take my dog ​​Monica there, and they've always been wonderful and taken the best possible care of my daughter. And now, with my Elvis and Cacharrito, I'm absolutely delighted. Susana's service couldn't be better, and Jacobo is a fantastic and incredibly friendly veterinarian. My little ones are always in their capable hands.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Always wonderful with my Lana!

I've been taking my dog ​​Lana to this veterinary clinic for a while now, and I couldn't be happier. The service is always caring, professional, and friendly. You can tell they love what they do and truly care about the animals' well-being. Lana goes in happy and comes out even happier. Thank you for taking such good care of her with so much love and dedication!

Wonderful staff, attentive, caring, and true professionals! Thank you so much.
I'm especially grateful to Diego for taking care of my ferret, Masik! He's a wonderful doctor who knows his stuff and cares about his patients. And Susanna is simply wonderful :) Thanks again for everything.

Alicia is a wonderful veterinarian. We met her at another veterinary clinic where she worked previously, and she greatly facilitated the uncertain and difficult time we went through with our kitten, Baba. Her warmth and professionalism made us feel very safe. She handled Baba's treatment with great care, and we always felt he was in good hands. In fact, unlike previous treatments with other veterinarians, our cat improved and is now doing well after suffering several relapses. We are extremely satisfied with her work and very grateful. She now works at Menescalia, and we want to assure you that if your pet is entrusted to her care, you can have complete confidence and peace of mind because she is an impeccable professional. :) Thank you so much for everything, Alicia!!! ♥️
Excellent service, top-notch. Super friendly to us and our dog.
Great professionals, thank you so much for taking care of our ferret 🥰 you're the best 😘 …

I doubt there's a better vet. I've been coming here for over 15 years with different animals, and it's always a great choice. When you're tired of going around in circles and hearing different opinions without getting anywhere, come here. 100% recommended
They have taken good care of my little one.
The service is excellent and the vet is superb. Highly recommended.
We are very grateful for the sincere and warm treatment we received. Thank you very much!
Excellent veterinarian
I took my dog ​​🐶 for a check-up after surgery. Everyone treated us very well and my dog ​​was happy!! …
Great professionals, very competent, empathetic with the owners and loving with the pets.
The service is excellent, I travel across the city to go there, the receptionist and assistant know the pets by name, Jacobo the veterinarian is very special.
For ferrets, which is what I have, they're the best, they're very good, if they were cheaper they'd be amazing.

Because my partner and I were traveling, our dog was with my mother. During that time, she tore off a nail and subsequently stopped eating, and we didn't know why. My mother looked for this veterinarian, and it was a great choice. Diego treated her, and he was excellent. He even video-called us to explain the problem. He checked on my mother every day to see how our dog was doing.
Last Sunday, we had an emergency and decided to take her back. Diego treated her again and was fantastic. We're sure we've found the perfect place to take our dog.
Very attentive and professional, they explain everything very well.

The best veterinarians I've ever seen. Jacobo, Diego, and Susana are all incredibly dedicated to their patients. The facilities are spotless and fully equipped. They offer radiology, lab work, ultrasounds, surgery, and more. This is Bogui's go-to veterinary clinic. 100% recommended. They also have a fantastic and reasonably priced Pet Health Plan.
Good service
Excellent service, they took great care of Bella, forever grateful.
I've been going to this clinic for years on the recommendation of a family member, and the service has always been outstanding. …
Very kind and professional. I took my puppy there and they gave me very good information about its care.
